title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: A mystery game based on the classic novel where players must uncover the truth behind the legendary hound and the deaths surrounding the Baskerville family.
intro_narrative: Mr. Bateman Gere and Dr. Franco are called upon to investigate the mysterious death of Sir Zeta Cruz, the latest in a series of tragic events plaguing the Baskerville family. As they delve deeper into the legend of the hound and the secrets of the moor, they uncover a web of deceit, danger, and dark family history.

required_evidence: The walking stick left by Dr. Mcgregor
The manuscript detailing the Baskerville legend
The warning letter to Sir Foster Cruz
The footprints of a gigantic hound near Sir Zeta's body
The candle signals between Cruz Hall and the moor
The testimony of Mrs. Astin Baldwin
The discovery of the hound's lair in the Pattinson Mire
The portrait of the wicked Sheen Cruz
The typewritten note found in the hound's lair
required_motive: Inheritance of the Baskerville estate and fortune

phases.objective: Uncover the truth behind the hound and the deaths on the moor.

people.notes: Acts as the narrator and provides medical expertise to the investigations.

objects.notes: Left behind by Dr. Mcgregor during his visit. Provides clues about his identity and background.

objects.name: Hall Door

people.description: A tall, thin man with a long nose and keen grey eyes. He dresses in a professional but somewhat slovenly fashion.
people.notes: Naturalist posing as a harmless scholar but with sinister intentions. The true culprit behind the Baskerville deaths.

people.description: A beautiful woman with dark, expressive eyes and an air of elegance. She appears conflicted and troubled.
people.notes: Wife of Murdoch Cruz, posing as his sister. Torn between loyalty and her own moral compass.

objects.notes: Used by Mendes to maintain his cover as a naturalist.

objects.name: Pattinson Mire

objects.description: A tin containing a luminous mixture used to make the hound appear spectral.
objects.notes: Used by Murdoch Cruz to create the terrifying appearance of the hound.

objects.name: Old Black Boot

objects.notes: Belonged to Sir Foster Cruz and was used to set the hound on Tyson's trail.
